risk_register.description: Link/backlink resolution errors due to ambiguous or mixed internal link syntax (e.g., Markdown links vs. WikiLinks), causing broken navigation and incorrect backlink lists.

mitigation.text: Specify supported link syntaxes (blocking decision) and implement a single canonical internal link model (normalized target IDs). Add fixture-based tests covering edge cases (relative paths, anchors, renamed files). Provide build warnings for unresolved links with source locations.

risk_register.description: Tag extraction inconsistency (frontmatter vs inline tags; nested tags) leads to missing/incorrect tag pages and filtering results.

mitigation.text: Lock a tag specification (blocking decision) and implement a deterministic parser with precedence rules (e.g., frontmatter overrides inline). Add validation that reports invalid tag tokens and produces a summary tag inventory at build time.

risk_register.description: Client-side XSS or content injection vulnerabilities if Markdown/HTML is rendered unsafely (e.g., raw HTML passthrough, unsafe link protocols), compromising readers of the static site.

mitigation.text: Use a sanitizer/renderer configuration that disables raw HTML by default (or sanitizes it), blocks javascript: URLs, and enforces safe attributes. Add security tests with known XSS payloads. Document an explicit opt-in for trusted HTML if needed.

risk_register.description: Search index quality/performance degradation at scale (slow queries, large JS payload, long build time) causing poor UX or unusable search on larger note sets.

mitigation.text: Define scale/performance targets (notes count, total MB). Choose an index approach suitable for in-browser search (tokenization, stemming optional). Implement incremental/optimized indexing, compression, and lazy loading of the index. Add benchmark fixtures and CI performance budgets.

risk_register.description: Slug/URL collisions (e.g., same filename in different folders, case-insensitive filesystems) cause pages to overwrite each other or links to resolve unpredictably.

mitigation.text: Define a deterministic slug strategy (include path segments or stable hashing). Detect collisions during build and fail with actionable errors unless an override map is provided.

risk_register.description: Non-deterministic builds (ordering differences, locale/time-dependent formatting) produce noisy diffs and inconsistent site output across machines/CI.

mitigation.text: Make builds deterministic: stable sorting of inputs, fixed locale/timezone handling, content-hash-based asset naming, and pinned dependency versions. Add a reproducibility check comparing outputs across two clean runs.

risk_register.description: Markdown flavor/extension mismatch (CommonMark vs GFM vs custom) yields rendering differences and broken formatting relative to user expectations.

mitigation.text: Select and document a supported Markdown flavor and extensions. Add a conformance test pack with representative notes. Provide a compatibility matrix and a strict mode that flags unsupported syntax.

risk_register.description: File encoding and Unicode handling issues (non-UTF8, mixed line endings) cause build failures or corrupted output text/search results.

mitigation.text: Assume UTF-8 by default but detect/handle BOM and common encodings where feasible. Normalize line endings internally. Emit clear diagnostics identifying offending files and provide a preflight validation command.

risk_register.description: Path traversal or unintended file inclusion during ingestion (e.g., following symlinks, reading outside the intended directory) leaks local files into the generated site.

mitigation.text: Constrain ingestion to a declared root directory, default to not following symlinks, and maintain an allowlist of file extensions. Add a safety check that rejects paths escaping the root and reports included files in a manifest.

risk_register.description: Backlink computation gaps for links with anchors, URL-encoded paths, or normalized titles lead to partially missing backlink lists.

mitigation.text: Normalize link targets consistently (decode, strip/standardize anchors, resolve relative paths) and store both page-level and section-level link relations. Add targeted tests for anchor links and encoded characters.

risk_register.description: Broken offline/local viewing due to browser security constraints (file:// restrictions) if the static site relies on fetch/XHR for the search index.

mitigation.text: Design search to work on static hosts and provide guidance for local preview (simple local server). Optionally support embedding the index into a JS bundle to avoid runtime fetch, or detect file:// and show instructions.

risk_register.description: Asset pipeline issues (broken relative paths, missing CSS/JS, incorrect base URL) lead to a site that works locally but fails when deployed under a subpath (e.g., GitHub Pages project pages).

mitigation.text: Support configurable basePath and generate all links/assets relative to it. Add a deployment-mode test that builds with a non-root basePath and runs a simple link/asset check over the output.

risk_register.description: Excessive memory usage or timeouts on large repositories causes build failures in CI or on user machines.

mitigation.text: Stream where possible, avoid loading all contents at once, and implement incremental indexing and caching. Provide a performance troubleshooting guide and configurable limits (max file size, exclude globs).

risk_register.description: Incorrect incremental rebuild/watch behavior (if implemented) leads to stale search index/backlinks after edits, confusing users.

mitigation.text: If watch mode is offered, implement a dependency graph so edits trigger recomputation of affected pages, backlinks, and search index. Provide a 'full rebuild' fallback and add tests for edit/rename/delete scenarios.

risk_register.description: Accessibility regressions (missing landmarks, poor contrast, non-keyboard navigable search UI) reduce usability for some readers.

mitigation.text: Adopt baseline accessibility guidelines for templates/components (semantic HTML, focus management, ARIA where needed). Add an accessibility checklist to review and at least one automated audit step during validation.

risk_register.description: Overly permissive configuration or plugin/theme extensibility (if added) introduces instability and makes outputs hard to support/reproduce.

mitigation.text: Keep the configuration surface minimal initially. Version configurations, validate schemas, and gate plugin execution behind explicit allowlists and warnings. Provide a safe default preset and a compatibility policy.

risk_register.description: Information disclosure via generated artifacts (e.g., including draft/private notes, or embedding absolute filesystem paths in HTML/JS or search index).

mitigation.text: Support exclude patterns (globs) and a 'private' frontmatter flag. Ensure generated output never includes absolute source paths; use relative identifiers only. Emit a build manifest listing included sources for review.

restrictions.notes: Read only the provided project capsule and prior drafts; no external sources.
Must be able to write audit spine/intake notes for traceability.

hitl_triggers: Missing or contradictory scope inputs (e.g., undefined link/tag specification) that block downstream design choices.
Any request to expand scope beyond static-site constraints.

restrictions.notes: Generation is drafting/planning only; do not execute or claim execution.
Do not include credentials, tokens, or private paths in any artifacts.

hitl_triggers: Proposed solution requires server-side runtime for search/backlinks (violates static constraint).
Proposed content rendering enables unsafe HTML without sanitization.

restrictions.notes: Validation writes must be limited to checklists/findings, not major scope edits.

hitl_triggers: Security-sensitive findings (e.g., XSS risk) without a concrete mitigation.
Performance targets are missing while performance-sensitive features are specified.

restrictions.notes: Review must be able to write findings and update audit spine.
Any decision affecting link/tag spec, security posture, or hosting assumptions must be logged in review findings.

hitl_triggers: Any acceptance of high/critical risks without explicit signoff rationale.
Any change to blocking open questions (Q1/Q2) without stakeholder approval.

restrictions.notes: Judge stage records accept/mitigate decisions; no new features introduced.

hitl_triggers: Unresolved blocking questions remain (Q1 or Q2).

restrictions.notes: Freeze produces final locked governance artifacts; edits require a new run.

hitl_triggers: Any attempt to modify frozen artifacts without a formal change request.

when_to_interrupt: Blocking specification decisions are required (internal link syntax Q1; tag representation Q2) and are not provided.
Any proposal that violates the static-site constraint (requires a server/database at runtime).
Any security-sensitive behavior is proposed (raw HTML passthrough, unsanitized rendering, unsafe URL schemes) without an explicit mitigation and reviewer approval.
Any high/critical risk is proposed for acceptance rather than mitigation.
Any ingestion behavior could read outside the intended directory (symlinks/path traversal) without explicit user confirmation.
